products.title: Bayswater
products.description: The Bayswater is considered a Mulberry bag icon. A timeless and classic shoulder bag, it unites the very best of Mulberry’s craft heritage and effortless style. The understated shape and finish showcases the exceptional level of leather quality, proudly finished with our signature Postman’s Lock. The interior belted sides can be adjusted to give more space inside, making the Bayswater ideal for any lifestyle.

products.title: Lily
products.description: The Lily is an effortlessly elegant style often chosen as an evening bag due to its versatile size and compact shape. The Lily has a woven leather and chain strap that can be worn short or long, and is finished with signature details such as our iconic Postman's Lock and leather padlock fob.
